title: 38mm FRP Grating: Industry Standard Size, Load Table & Specifications
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Why 38mm is the most popular FRP grating thickness. Complete load table, span capacity, chemical resistance, price and applications guide.
content:
1. Why 38mm is the Industry Standard

38mm (1.5 inch) molded FRP grating is the most widely used size worldwide. It balances cost, load capacity and durability for industrial walkways, platforms and flooring. Used in chemical plants, wastewater treatment, food processing, power plants and marine facilities. Standard panel: 1220 x 3660mm (4x12ft), also available 1220x2440mm.

2. Load Capacity & Span Table (38mm)

UDL with safety factor 5: Span 900mm: 250 kg/m2. Span 1000mm: 200 kg/m2. Span 1200mm: 150 kg/m2. Span 1500mm: 90 kg/m2. Point load (50x50mm, 5mm deflection): 1200N at 900mm span. Suitable for: pedestrians, handcarts, light service carts. Not for: forklifts, pallet trucks, heavy wheel loads.

3. Resin Options for 38mm Grating

Isophthalic polyester (standard): general chemical resistance, wastewater, mild acid/alkali. Temperature: -20C to +80C. Vinyl ester: strong acid/alkali, offshore, chemical plants. Temperature: -20C to +120C. Phenolic: fire-resistant V-0, high voltage, oil & gas. Note: phenolic available on request.

4. Price & Availability (2026)

38mm isophthalic: USD 48-62/m2 FOB. 38mm vinyl ester: USD 62-82/m2. 38mm phenolic: USD 85-110/m2. Standard colors: yellow, grey, green. Lead time: 7-15 days for stock sizes, 20-25 days for custom colors/resins.

5. Typical Applications

Chemical plant walkways and platforms. Wastewater treatment tank covers. Pulp & paper mill floors. Food processing (white resin). Marine decking and pontoons. Power plant turbine platforms. Brewery and dairy flooring. Electroplating shop platforms.

6. Installation Tips

Use M-clips, C-clips or Z-clips on steel or FRP support beams. 4 clips per panel, 6-8 for heavy vibration areas. Cut with diamond blade or jigsaw with carbide tip. Wear PPE for dust. Allow thermal expansion: do not over-tighten clips. Email sales@gratingfrp.com for installation manual.
